placement: Capability Pack: src/capabilities/store/ and its contract unit (limen.store version 2, additive). New requests persist, persisted, estimate and availability over navigator.storage and indexedDB, answered Persisted, Persistence, Estimate, Availability or Unsupported; the pack never asks for persistence on its own. Opened reports whether this open created the database. A connection the browser closes abnormally (storage cleared or evicted) is forgotten and reported as the fact ConnectionLost; later requests on it are NotOpen. Version 1 registrations refuse all of it as malformed and keep 0.7.x behaviour. The packs smoke runner gains a DevTools clear-site-data action for the Chromium ConnectionLost scenario. Bindings regenerated. Core, the kernel, contract/targets.json and every guardrail path are unchanged.
